role: non-RULER independent-example multiple-choice replication of the natural adaptive layer-quota contrast
prerequisites: terminal digest-bound nine-seed P2 causal audit
terminal Qwen3-4B adaptive-quota RULER audit regardless of outcome
terminal baseline Qwen3-4B LongBench v2 audit regardless of outcome
verified frozen LongBench v2 dataset, source, prompt, scorer, model, and fixed-baseline selection
execution_policy: run all 503 frozen examples under both arms; prerequisite outcomes never select, cancel, truncate, or reorder examples

benchmark.name: LongBench-v2
benchmark.paired_unit: the same frozen example with identical rendered prompt and exact token ids under both arms
benchmark.secondary_slice_policy: report observed frozen metadata levels with n >= 10 descriptively; no slice is a confirmation gate

natural-adaptive-quota+pins.layer_signal: normalized entropy concentration of z-scored current-layer scorer values
natural-adaptive-quota+pins.causal_prior: running mean of earlier-layer concentrations only

scorer_selection.rule: reuse the frozen score-compatible Qwen selection without LongBench v2 outcome inspection

physical_contract.question_tokens: append identically to both compressed context caches after allocation
per_successful_example_audit: all 36 context-prefill layer allocations in causal order
configured and observed total kept tokens
score concentration and controller time per layer
hot-resident bytes, peak HBM, latency, and operational failure

failure_reporting.paired_scoring_policy: retain every frozen example and score allowed failures zero

statistics.failure_policy: intention-to-evaluate; every operational or unsupported-context failure scores zero and is never dropped or silently retried

claim_boundary: A passing result supports bounded replication of the causal equal-global-budget layer-quota heuristic on one Qwen3-4B LongBench v2 multiple-choice cohort. It does not establish performance on open-ended generation, continuous refresh, dynamic serving, cross-model transfer, the full natural suite, or official DeepSeek-V4 behavior.
